rationale: Section 13 (continuing at p0090) does contain a Garman-side IP indemnity tied to breach of its ownership/non-infringement warranty, with procure/modify/replace remedies (p0091-p0093) and no fee-only refund escape, and Section 15 expressly carves breaches of Section 13 out of the liability cap (p0105) with survival confirmed in Section 18. So the walk-away and the "indemnity absent / IP excluded" triggers are not met, and there is no offsetting Sparkling indemnity to narrow. However, the clause falls short of our preferred position in four respects: (1) it is indemnify-and-hold-harmless only, with no obligation to defend third-party claims; (2) it covers only Sparkling and its officers and directors, not our affiliated companies, even though Section 2 licenses the Work for use by Sparkling affiliates at Authorized Locations; (3) there is no claim-handling procedure (control of defence, no settlement binding us without consent, cooperation), and the sole procedural term is a hard ten-calendar-day notice requirement with no materiality or prejudice qualifier, which risks being read as a condition precedent forfeiting the indemnity; and (4) the indemnity is limited to breach of the IP warranty and gives us nothing for Garman's breach of applicable law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of our data or Confidential Information caused by Garman, or Garman's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 makes the maintenance term "renewable" but is silent on how renewal happens, on the notice we must give and on renewal pricing, so we have added standard mechanics: successive twelve-month renewals, a thirty-day opt-out for us, a sixty-day renewal reminder from Garman, and a renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%. If a hard cap is difficult we can accept a 5% ceiling with a sixty-day non-renewal window.

ops.text:
(d) MAINTENANCE TERM AND RENEWAL

The maintenance term shall renew automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless Sparkling gives Garman written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) calendar days before the end of the then-current maintenance term. Garman shall notify Sparkling in writing of the upcoming renewal, and of the maintenance fees proposed for the renewal term, at least sixty (60) calendar days before the end of the then-current maintenance term. Maintenance fees for any renewal term shall not exceed the fees for the then-current term by more than the lesser of (i) the percentage increase in the Consumer Price Index over the then-current term and (ii) three percent (3%).
